Hi there! Any 503 response that affected the production API would be recorded on our status page. The page lists every incident—including brief ones—with the exact start and end times and shows which component (e.g., the API) was impacted. You can review the incident history there to see if the window you experienced matches a reported event, and you’ll also find a component‑level breakdown to confirm it was a platform‑wide issue. If you’d like to be notified of incidents as they happen, you can subscribe to status‑page updates.

Feel free to let us know if you need any help locating the specific entry.
